data.name: Evangelynn
data.gender_notes: Evangelynn is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Evangelynn is a compound name derived from the Greek word 'evangelion' meaning 'good news' or 'gospel', and the Latin suffix '-ynn' which is a diminutive form of 'Evangeline' or 'Little Good News Bearer'. The name is popularly used among Christian communities to honor the biblical figures like the three Wise Men who brought the news of Jesus' birth, the Angels who spread the news of Jesus' birth or resurrection, or the evangelists who shared the teachings of Jesus with the world.
data.spiritual_meaning: Carrier of good news, messenger of hope
data.etymology: Evangelynn belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bringing good news.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Evangelynn total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

historical_references.reference: The name Evangelynn may have originated from the Greek word 'evangelion' meaning 'good news'. During the early Christian period, 'evangelist' was a title given to those who spread the teachings of Jesus Christ. Thus, the name Evangelynn could have been given to a child born during this time in honor of a religious figure or event.

Another possible origin of the name Evangelynn is from the Old French word 'evangile', meaning 'gospel'. During the Middle Ages, 'evangelist' was a title given to those who wrote and copied religious texts, such as the gospels. Thus, the name Evangelynn could have been given to a child born during this time in honor of a religious text or figure associated with the spread of Christianity.
